label: Apply the existing joint borrowing trap to the adoption-product pair
meaning: The selected pair contains no independently supplied role. Each actual record entering it requires the opposite role within it, even if a necessary source is another contributor. Apply DerivativeJointPower.trap_obstruction to both members. This is a narrow reuse application whose new research role is fixed by the matched restoration controls; it does not independently defend inductive supply or identify semantic dependence with productive prerequisites.
